title: Unique Crunchy Kenyan Lamb Skewers
description: A peppery and crunchy Kenyan dish featuring lamb stock, perfect for a brunch mood, and diabetic-friendly. This recipe is made with a mortar-pestle-pound technique.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a mortar, pound the black peppercorns, coriander seeds, and cumin seeds into a coarse powder.
Add the garlic and ginger to the mortar and pound until well combined.
Add the lamb cubes to the mortar and mix until they are evenly coated with the spice mixture.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with salt.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the lamb is cooked through.
Serve the skewers hot with a side of lamb stock and a squeeze of lemon juice.
